effect_description_eng: [Main] You may suspend this Digimon to digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card with the [Fairy] trait trait in your hand. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer in play, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
